headline: Eleven years scrub experience across two NHS trusts, currently working nights, and available at two weeks' notice.

evidence.text: Holds current NMC registration, renewed this year.
Eight years scrub in orthopaedic theatres, including primary and revision arthroplasty.
evidence.source_quote: Senior Staff Nurse, Orthopaedic Theatres, Queen Victoria Hospital, 2018-2026. Primary and revision hip and knee arthroplasty, trauma lists.

evidence.text: Has worked a permanent night rota for the last two years.

process_fit.text: The trust interviews with the theatre manager and a senior scrub nurse together, so expect a clinical scenario rather than a competency grid.
process_fit.source_quote: Panel is always Sarah (theatre manager) plus one senior scrub. They run a scenario, not a competency framework.

process_fit.text: They turned down the last candidate for not asking about the on-call arrangement, so brief this one to raise it.
process_fit.source_quote: Rejected our last one because he didn't ask a single question about on-call. Sarah reads that as not really wanting nights.

gaps.text: No documented paediatric theatre experience, which the brief lists as desirable.
gaps.source_quote: Orthopaedic Theatres, Queen Victoria Hospital, 2018-2026. Primary and revision hip and knee arthroplasty, trauma lists.

open_questions: Confirm the candidate can start on the 11th rather than the 18th.
Check whether the trust requires a separate scrub competency sign-off.
